## Summary

**Constraint screening:** 30 of 100 pool candidates violate the hard constraints (Mo ≤ 3.21 wt% and cost index ≤ 450 using the given prices), leaving **70 feasible candidates**.

**Modeling** (features: 12 alloying element wt% + 4 processing numerics + one-hot `heat_treatment`/`route`, Fe excluded as linearly dependent); model comparison via 5-fold CV:
- HistGradientBoosting variants: ~67–68 MPa MAE
- GradientBoosting: ~90 MPa; ExtraTrees/RandomForest: ~100 MPa MAE

I built a **stacked ensemble** (3 HGB configs + GBR + ET, multi-seed averaged) with a positive-linear meta-learner fitted on out-of-fold predictions — stacked CV MAE ≈ **63 MPa**, better than any single model. Individual HGB, equal-weight ensemble, and stacked ensemble all nominate the same top-5 set, so the pick is stable:

| Rank | ID | Pred (MPa) | Mo | Cost | Treatment | Route |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | c019 | ~1940 | 2.662 | 385.4 | solution_aged | AM |
| 2 | c092 | ~1936 | 2.600 | 434.8 | quench_temper | AM |
| 3 | c007 | ~1910 | 0.0 | 411.2 | quench_temper | wrought |
| 4 | c068 | ~1898 | 0.0 | 379.2 | solution_aged | wrought |
| 5 | c044 | ~1895 | 0.949 | 386.7 | quench_temper | cast |

All five pass both feasibility checks (Mo ≤ 3.21, cost ≤ 450).

Final: c019, c092, c007, c068, c044
